snippet.title: Chess Arena - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
We turned chess into a video game! It's a Battle Royale with 40 players, a giant chessboard, and ONE winner. 
Inspired from Fortnite, as well as RTS, MOBA, and many other games.

➡️ Signup To Playtest on steam : https://steam.pm/app/3202290/
➡️ Discord : https://discord.gg/b7exyuVSKH
✉️ News Letter : https://Chessarena.gg/
